en.name: Jasna Góra Basilica, Częstochowa
en.summary: Poland's most important shrine, home to the venerated icon of the Black Madonna.
en.body: Founded by Pauline monks in 1382, the monastery and basilica at Jasna Góra enshrine the Black Madonna of Częstochowa, an icon credited with a defense of the monastery in 1655 and revered as a symbol of Polish Catholic identity.
